scope.interaction: select the sessionless thread, open Model Picker, choose Big Pickle, and persist the new model

productLoss: The Lynx picker consumed the ready-provider projection subset even though ChatView had already derived the complete provider catalog.
When the current idle thread referenced an unavailable Codex instance while another provider was ready, the Codex rail opened with no selectable rows, so no model change could be initiated.
The fix feeds the complete presentation catalog to the picker and defaults an unlocked picker to the first ready provider while preserving the current provider for locked sessions.
harnessMismatch: The first Browser diagnostic reported pass after the overlay had already closed; overlay=null, zero rows, and providerInputChannel=pending invalidate that frame.

The strict Browser diagnostic retained both overlays but Web authority stayed on unavailable Codex while Lynx selected a ready provider, so finalOverlayReady correctly failed. That cross-client default-provider parity remains open and is not counted as this Native product fix.
classification.evidenceBoundary: This exact-bundle run closes the Native model-selection content, interaction, persistence, and runtime defect. It does not claim Browser default-provider parity, fullscreen backdrop parity, Native geometry parity, or Native material parity.

selection.input: DevTool Input.emulateTouchFromMouseEvent on measured Sidebar thread, model trigger, and model row

build.native: pass with existing unsupported-property and import.meta warnings

validation.agentBrowserLeakGate: Every owned loop reported owned=0 orphaned=0; an external Synara session was informational only and completed its own cleanup.

remainingRisk: Web authority and Lynx-for-Web still choose different default provider rails when the persisted provider is unavailable.
Model Picker fullscreen dim-overlay parity remains a separate user-reported scope.
Native keyboard navigation, geometry parity, and material parity are not claimed by this mutation run.
